aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes software for food trucks and catering: online orders, collection times, fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering: they take online orders and manage collection times, orders flow smoothly, and less time goes on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change this.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools made to fit how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with one simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating the Village Foodie directory, which helps people find food trucks coming to their area, I studied the difficulties mobile food businesses face more closely. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system relies on each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system keep my kitchen from being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with its places and times, and customers order for the place and day you will be there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does the system work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not available yet.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel at any time; payment is taken monthly in advance, and access remains until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. Ask your tax adviser how to record online orders in the till.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on the spot, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card terminal takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you hand out a buzzer, record its number on the order — you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen showing customers order numbers and when they will be ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place: food hygiene, insurance, gas safety and so on. We remind you before they expire, and you can send them to an event or fair organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with their own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at one time and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combos and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-replies, but for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens side by side — at the till and in the kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login details with the right access level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering is paused, so customers cannot place orders you will not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs internet.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take the card payment upfront via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set the last time for orders on items that need advance preparation.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private order link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see the real profit at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or a picture you already post on Facebook. All you do is review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Customers are sent an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add the dates, places and times for each week and event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item “Sold out” with one tap — it turns grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count — it goes down with each order, and when it runs out the item becomes “Sold out” automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone — no separate card terminal needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so the load is spread across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the truck’s window; payment is taken on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-replies: enquiries about your menu and schedule are answered automatically.

landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, the tablet at the till, the laptop in the van — and on the card terminal you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, a reliable Wi-Fi network and the same working hours every week. But you work somewhere new every week, at different times, where mobile coverage is poor or absent. HatchGrab was made exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering is paused automatically, so customers cannot place orders you will not see. Keep taking orders through the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already publish on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in the dates, places and times ourselves — ready to share every week or every day.

landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” While you are driving to your spot or standing at the grill, your WhatsApp messages get answered from your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram are coming soon.
